name: io.github.0xdopewilly/fusebox-mcp
title: Fusebox
description: Agent payments on X Layer checked by TapeOut circuit fuses: check, pay, x402 fetch, ready rules.

environmentVariables.name: FUSEBOX_WALLET
environmentVariables.description: The Fusebox wallet the agent pays from (default: Atlas, the public demo wallet)

environmentVariables.name: FUSEBOX_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The wallet's agent key; without it the server is read-only. It can only ask the wallet to pay.

environmentVariables.name: FUSEBOX_MAX_PRICE
environmentVariables.description: Default cap on what fusebox_fetch pays per x402 call, in USDT0 (default 0.10)
